services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Cruise inside of Alamitos Bay in Long Beach. This tour offers the calmest waters of all our boat tours because we will stay inside of Alamitos Bay for your entire tour. This is a great way to enjoy Long Beach and the perfect way to spend a romantic evening with a loved one or just hangout with friends. Cruise our local waters from Long Beach to San Pedro and see sights like the Queen Mary, San Pedro a working harbor and visit the Battleship USS Iowa and we should see sea life like seals on our tour, or go out in open water and do some whale watching. services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: On these trips we will be fishing along the coast in the Long Beach / Los Angeles area, where ever we feel the fishing will be the best. These trips normally target calico bass, sand bass, halibut, and rock fish . The cost of the trip includes all fishing tackle, bait, crew and fish cleaning. Not included is your California fishing license or tips for the crew. Feel free to bring anything you wish to eat or drink. These trip usually depart around 8AM and return around 1:00 pm.
